command: set -e; pnpm tokens:build; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; RAW_SVG=$(git grep -n '<svg' -- apps/mobile/src | grep '.tsx:' | grep -v '/__tests__/' || true); test -z "$RAW_SVG"; INLINE=$(git grep -n 'style={{' -- apps/mobile/src | grep '.tsx:' | grep -v '/__tests__/' || true); test -z "$INLINE"; MARKERS=$(git grep -n -E 'TODO|FIXME|HACK|@ts-ignore|eslint-disable|console[.](log|debug)|as any' -- apps/mobile/src packages ':!**/dist/**' || true); test -z "$MARKERS"; echo TOKEN_HYGIENE_OK; find apps/mobile/src -type f | grep -E '[.]tsx?$' | grep -v '/__tests__/' | xargs wc -l | sort -nr | head -12
